670-1619-5361-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.

670-1619-5361-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Auton Soldier each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-5361-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Repeat step 6 for each remaining Mana Echoes trigger created in steps 2 and 4.

Choose to return Jirina to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Jirina dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 8, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve a Blasting Station trigger from step 5, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Human Soldier.
When the Human Soldier dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 13, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 12 one additional time if you control a Human Soldier.
Activate Blasting Station twice by sacrificing Jirina and a Human Soldier.
Activate up to three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding any combination of {R}, {W} and {B}.
Repeat.
